preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t are the same.
String s is lexicographically smaller than string t.

postconditions.expression: result == 'No such string' or (s < result < t and len(result) == len(s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in result))
postconditions.description: The result is either 'No such string' or a string that is lexicographically larger than s and smaller than t, consisting of lowercase English letters and having the same length as s and t.
